# Row 0 (df index 0): Turkey, Apple, Milk, Red, ..., Value, Apple
# Row 1 (df index 1): Rooster, Watermelon, Tea, Yellow, ..., Result, NaN
#
# The instruction asks to count instances of a specific text/number in a column matching a specified header.
# Based on the spreadsheet layout:
# Cell H2 (Row 0, Col H) = "Value" (Label)
# Cell I2 (Row 0, Col I) = "Apple" (The value to search for)
# Cell H3 (Row 1, Col H) = "Result" (Label)
# Cell I3 (Row 2, Col I) = Target Answer Position
#
# The "Fruits" column is the one containing "Apple".
# We need to count how many times "Apple" appears in the "Fruits" column.

# Extract the target value from cell I2 (Row 0, Col 8 in pandas)
target_value = df.iloc[0, 8] # "Apple"
target_column_name = "Fruits"

# Calculate the count of the target value in the target column
# We use .sum() on a boolean series to get the count
count = (df[target_column_name] == target_value).sum()

# Write the result to I3 using openpyxl
# I3 corresponds to row 3, column 9 in openpyxl (1-indexed)
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(file_path)
ws = wb.active

# Ensure we are writing a literal integer to the answer position
ws.cell(row=3, column=9).value = int(count)

# Save the output to the specified path
output_path = '/mnt/data/outputs/46897_0_71ceca65/1_46897_output.xlsx'
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)",
